text:
Amal: Planning to flip feature flag `quant_config=audience_surgical_int4` for ~2% of prod traffic next Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Quick sync: canary size, rollback gates, preload kernels, alert thresholds. Who's available for a sanity check? :eyes:

Ravi: +1. 2% sounds fine. Proposed audience: user_id % 100 < 2 (non-enterprise). Exclude paid-enterprise tiers and internal-beta. I'll stage targeting in LaunchDarkly. Plan: 15m canary then keep at 2% if no regressions.

Sophia: What eval metrics do we want to watch? I'll add a sampling job. Suggest: p50/p95 latency, error_rate, and quality diffs (EM/F1) on the eval set. Also check rerank drift.

Linh: Infra note: prewarm model instances on the nodes. Run 10 warmup requests with seq_len=128 to populate KV caches. For GPU types, prefer p4d/gn5 — avoid old M40s for int4 kernels. Also set `max_batch=8` for int4 runtime.

Marc: Oncall -> set circuit breaker: if p95 latency increases >30% for 5m OR error_rate >1% -> automatic rollback to fp16 variant. I'll add alerts + runbook. Keep fallback model pinned to `redwood-v1-fp16`.

Amal: OK can someone paste the exact flag payload we'll push so I can apply it and link the dashboard?

Ravi: here's the snippet I'll push to LD and commit to infra repo:
```yaml
flag_key: quant_surgical_int4
enabled: false
targets:
  - audience: 'surgical-2pct'
  - exclude: ['enterprise', 'internal-beta']
variants:
  - name: int4
    model: redwood-v1-int4
    runtime_config:
      max_batch: 8
      prewarm_requests: 10
      kernel_hint: 'fast-kv'
rollout:
  start: '2026-04-07T02:00:00Z'
  duration_minutes: 120
  canary_minutes: 15
metrics:
  - p50_latency
  - p95_latency
  - error_rate
rollback_conditions:
  - p95 > baseline*1.3 for 5m
  - error_rate > 0.01
```

Sophia: Add `quality_check: sample_eval_suite_v2` under metrics so we trigger manual review if EM drops >0.5% on the sampled prompts. Also tag traffic for A/B analysis.

Linh: Also set node draining grace to 90s to avoid in-flight token losses during rollback. And ensure autoscaler doesn't spin up mixed instance types mid-canary.

ops-bot: Deploy job queued: launcher/flags #4523 by Ravi. Preview: https://ld.redwood.company/flags/quant_surgical_int4

Marc: I'll be oncall during the window. @Amal add me to LaunchDarkly approvers and the rollout tracker.

Amal: done. I'll create a small dashboard with p50/p95/error_rate/EM and link it here. @Ravi, please paste dashboard links when you push the flag. If anything looks off, flip to `off` immediately. :thumbsup:

Ravi: Will do. Also opening a tiny PR for the config in infra repo, pinging @Sophia for review on the quality gating bits.

Sophia: Reviewed the PR, left two tiny doc nits. Will approve once fixed.

Amal: Logging this rollout in tracker: https://tracker.redwood/incidents/rollouts/1932101111

ops-bot: Reminder: run smoke tests after flip:
`curl -H 'x-test: canary' https://api.redwood.company/generate -d '{ "prompt": "smoke" }'`

Ravi: After deploy I'll post the LD audit URL + dashboard links here.

Amal: Perfect — thanks everyone. We'll go ahead if docs + approvals are green.
